title: Speedy Libs
description:
**Task:**
Given a singular word and a line of text, replace all ‘{insert}’s with the given word. 

**Input:**
Hello
{insert} World!

**Output:**
Hello World!

**Explanation:**
The substring ‘{insert}’ is replaced by the word ‘Hello’ resulting in a sentence of ‘Hello World!’.

test_cases.input:
I
{insert} am a proud programmer because {insert} was able to solve TH{insert}S challenging problem!
test_cases.expected: I am a proud programmer because I was able to solve THIS challenging problem!

title: You've got it backwards!
description:
**Task:**

Turns out, you f***ed up. You got everything backwards. Reverse the input text to revert to normal state!

**Input:**

```nohtyp```

**Output:**

```python```

**Explanation:**
The word 'nohtyp' when reversed becomes 'python'!
